description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Serve as the lead engineer on one client engagement at a time, spending days at the client's location to learn how their operation runs, then designing and refining software and automated decision tools until they are in live use. Act as the main technical point of contact, pass client requirements to the product group, and package repeated tasks into shared tools. Frequent travel is expected.
 What you'll do
 - Lead the technical work on a customer deployment and act as their main technical contact.
 - Gather process knowledge from subject-matter experts and convert it into structured software models.
 - Build and ship production software and automated agents, with tests and clear documentation.
 - Evaluate whether automated outputs are accurate and correct them when they fall short.
 - Respond quickly to customer feedback during a deployment.
 - Share customer needs that the current product does not meet with the product team.
 - Manage technical relationships with operators, IT staff and executives.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - At least one year of professional software engineering experience, gained before AI coding tools became common, or a computer science degree plus consulting work.
 - Production coding skill in Python or TypeScript, plus SQL.
 - Clear customer-facing experience in forward deployed, solutions engineering or technical consulting work, or other strong communication evidence such as conference talks, debate or student leadership.
 - Hands-on experience building something substantive with large language models or agents, at work or independently.
 - Able and willing to spend roughly a quarter to half of working time away at client sites, up to three days in a typical week.
 Bonus points
 - Background in factory, supply chain, freight or other industrial operations, including familiarity with enterprise resource, manufacturing execution or transport management software.
 - Prior forward deployed engineering experience.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 155,000 to 185,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Chicago, Illinois, United States
 - Hybrid, 3 days a week in office
 - Full-time
